desc: The Phoenix line of Side by Sides delivers beauty, elegance, and performance. Featuring a Case Colored receiver. Available in two gauges, each built on a true steel frame with precision laser engraved detail. The Phoenix comes standard with Select Turkish walnut, high-gloss stock, 5 chokes Beretta Mobil (SK, IC, M, IM, F), brass bead front sight, and a selective top tang safety. A Side by Side with competition-grade craftsmanship at Field Grade pricing.
